result.verdict:
Short version: most round-1 points on the new handoff and on the two drafts are resolved, and the corrected numbers hold. Two round-1 points are resolved only in part, and I found 12 new points. Three of them are wrong statements that the corrections added: one sentence of section 3.8, one bullet of the #5433 draft, and the claim that an empty pgrep output proves that nothing is active.

What I checked and found right:
- TTFT table of section 3.4 and of the #5433 draft: all 18 values equal my recomputation from collected.json (arms a0 and a, medians of ttft_max over repetitions 11 to 13). Unrounded falls: 11.18, 8.67, 6.94, 12.13, 9.62, 7.64 %. Both arms have tip 8351e4ad52. Arm p0 against arm a gives 6.88 to 12.40 %, as the text says. Load of these runs: our-app-cores 0.0 to 0.1 %, socket0 42.4 to 42.5 %.
- Labels: S1 to S4, N1 to N7, X1 to X10, stages 1 to 3, trees A to F, [C1], [D1], [D2] and every "section N" reference exist. One label is broken: "way 2" in section 5.2.
- pgrep line of section 5.1: the file holds one backslash before each dot (`[b]uild\.sh`, `[r]un-one\.sh`), inside a fenced code block, with the pattern in single quotes inside double quotes. That is right. A local test showed no match on its own shell.
- "16 key heads and 32 value heads": supported. t/t_gated_delta_net.cpp at 72e1191804, lines 1227 to 1232 ("recurrence step at the Qwen head geometry", n_key_heads 16, n_value_heads 32), and the run records of model ingested-qwen-3.5-4b-tp4 in collected.json (n_key_heads 16, n_value_heads 32, 24 operations).
- "jhan's only issue on numerics": supported. gh lists 21 issues of the account, and only #4444 concerns numerics. It was opened 2026-09-16T03:13Z, 4 h 19 min after PR #3879 merged, while PR #4424 was open.
- "differs in comments and tests only": git diff 8351e4ad52 775bba7661 on h and src changes comment lines only. The diff also holds README.ci.md and README.stats.md (see the findings).
- Test lines at 775bba7661: the three normalization cases start at lines 405, 434 and 462, and our chain and block cases start at line 2840.
- Section 6.3: "keep EXEC" fits build.sh line 25 and run-one.sh lines 54 and 63. NAME is fixed in the four scripts named. unit-tests.sh has no NAME. Gaps are in the findings.
- Issue #4444 has 3 comments, the newest of 2026-10-19, so "not posted" is true. All TVD values of section 3.6 and of the #4444 draft reproduce from the per-step files.
- The four commit ids of section 5.1 and the state of PR #5571 and issue #5433 are unchanged.

Not checked (no ssh): the reboot time, the load average 61.00, the 2.9 TB free space, the build trees on delphi-3b35, and whether python3 on delphi-3b35 has numpy.

round1_not_resolved.why: The main error is resolved: section 6.3 now says to keep EXEC. Four parts of the finding are not carried, and the new advice adds a fifth. (1) The arm tables ARMS_ALL of token-check.sh, logit-margin.sh and campaign.sh know only the tags base, ctr, pa, pab and partb, and token-check.sh compares every arm with the arm base (line 55). (2) unit-tests.sh runs the two switch rows on the tag pab only (lines 45 to 48), so a copy with new TAGS gives no GDN-switch row for the new trees. (3) run-one.sh line 43 ends with exit code 0 and the words "already done" when the log of that run name exists; token-check.sh line 43 and logit-margin.sh line 59 skip too. A control "the same arm twice" (section 5.5 step 5) with one run name then compares one record with itself. (4) campaign.sh writes MARKER under $EXEC/logs (line 30), outside the root. (5) New: section 6.3 says to keep EXEC and to change NAME, but logit-margin.sh line 66 calls "$EXEC/$NAME/logit_summary.py". With a new NAME that path does not exist.
round1_not_resolved.fix:
Add to section 6.3:
- `logit-margin.sh` finds `logit_summary.py` at `$EXEC/$NAME/` (line 66). After you change `NAME`, write that path in full.
- `campaign.sh` also writes `MARKER` under `$EXEC/logs` (line 30). Point it into the root.
- The arm tables (`ARMS_ALL`) are fixed in `token-check.sh`, `logit-margin.sh` and `campaign.sh`. They know only the tags `base`, `ctr`, `pa`, `pab` and `partb`. Add your arms. `token-check.sh` compares every arm with the arm `base` (line 55).
- `unit-tests.sh` runs the two switch rows on the tag `pab` only (lines 45 to 48). Change them to your tags.
- `run-one.sh` (line 43), `token-check.sh` (line 43) and `logit-margin.sh` (line 59) skip a run whose output file exists. `run-one.sh` then exits with 0. Give every repeat and every control run its own run name.

result.verdict:
Not yet safe to hand over, but close. Most round-1 points on the split handoff are resolved, and every fact that the corrections added holds where I could check it. Left: 4 round-1 remainders and 9 new points. Three of the new points come from the corrections themselves (the PR 2 row, the question on closing PR #5572, the new Q2 = no rule).

CHECKED AND CORRECT
- Review states (gh, 2026-11-23 12:15 PST): #3206, #5345, #3205, #3221, #5023, #5024, #3689, #3690, #3692, #3694, #3695 are CHANGES_REQUESTED. #5486 is APPROVED. So "11 of the 12, only #5486" holds. PR #3689: mergeable CONFLICTING, mergeStateStatus DIRTY.
- Old TTFT medians of the arm orig, recomputed from collected-controls.json (median of ttft_max over repetitions 21 to 23): 0.383741 s in cell q35-tp4-1u-p1024, 1.897475 s in q35-tp4-1u-p4096, 2.909528 s in q35-tp4-8u-p1024. The file's 0.384 s, 1.897 s and 2.91 s are right. The 8 users of one run differ by 0.1 ms, so the largest value and the mean are the same number here.
- Section 7.5 control start: arms orig, st, orig0, st0 on those 3 cells. The old control ran base, nost, orig (final-chain.sh line 41). - [R18], second link: DM D0AVD4EG675, ts 1795459646.960159 = 10:47:26 PST. Its text carries both bullets of section 0.1 (merge of PR #5022 on approval; "Current blocker is, Runar has not merge PR3696 yet"). The five group-chat quotes match word for word. Not checked: that the DM partner is one of the "two colleagues" of the group chat (the tool shows no member list).

- "Three places" for Part 0: line 418 of gated_delta_net.hpp at 775bba7661 holds the value rounding; PR #5571 takes the executor from 5 to 2 rounding lines (3 dropped, all in postprocess).
- 3 of the 21 commits of the model's branch are on main as the same patch (git cherry). Merge base 54476c6581 of 2026-11-16. main is still f454423b09. PR #5572 is still an open draft with 0 comments. No split branch exists.

- Not checked (no ssh): reboot time 08:55 UTC, the content of /dev/hugepages, 2.9 TB free.

new_findings.location: Section 7.1, last rule: the pgrep line and "No output means that nothing runs." (lines 687-692)
new_findings.problem: The quoting is right and the brackets work. The coverage is wrong. The pattern holds no script name of a campaign. Between two runs of a campaign start no runtron process exists: campaign.sh sleeps 5 s, and run-one.sh samples the load for 10 s before each run. In the campaign of 2026-11-22 the time without a runtron process was 47 % of the main start (mean cycle 35.4 s, runtron 18.7 s, 107 cycles) and 59 % of the control start (28.3 s, 11.7 s, 26 cycles). So "No output means that nothing runs" fails for about half of the time of a campaign of the other task. If the split agent starts in such a gap, its run opens our cards, and run-one.sh of the other campaign then refuses its next runs (exit 3; three failed runs in a row end a campaign). The lock files do not help: they carry the campaign name. Second point: the handoff of the rounding task now holds another line (with `[r]un-one\.sh`), so the two files no longer make the same check, and that line still misses the 5 s sleep. Third point: the brackets fail when the check stands in one command line with a bare script name, because the remote shell then holds that name.
new_findings.evidence: Computed from /home/jhan/workspace/intel-AMX/exec/logs/gdn-impl-20261121-campaign.log (start lines) and the wall= fields of rt-results.txt. campaign.sh: "sleep 5" after each run. run-one.sh: "# 1. load snapshot (10 s sample)". /home/jhan/workspace/smaller-tasks/numeric-rounding/handoff-numeric-rounding-20261123.md line 426. Local test: with a sleeping `bash .../campaign.sh`, the pattern of the file gave no output and rc=1; the pattern below found it.
new_findings.fix: `ssh delphi-3b35 "pgrep -u jhan -fa '[r]untron|[n]inja|[c]make|[b]uild\.sh|[c]ampaign\.sh|[r]un-one\.sh|[t]oken-check\.sh|gen/[t]_|[a]mx_gdn_bench'"`. The brackets keep the calling shell out of the result. Run the check as a command of its own: a script name elsewhere in the same command line makes the shell match itself. A campaign has no runtron process for about half of its time, so the script names are part of the pattern. No output means that nothing runs. Use the same line in the handoff of the rounding task [R20].
